core_competencies.name: Problem decomposition
core_competencies.description: Clarifies requirements, constraints, edge cases, and success criteria before implementation.

core_competencies.name: Technical depth
core_competencies.description: Explains algorithm, system, data, code quality, testing, and trade-off reasoning.

core_competencies.name: Production ownership
core_competencies.description: Connects implementation to reliability, maintainability, observability, user impact, and post-launch learning.

core_competencies.name: Technical communication
core_competencies.description: Thinks aloud, explains decisions, receives hints, and collaborates under ambiguity.

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Asks precise questions and defines assumptions before solving.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Jumps into code or design with hidden assumptions.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: What constraints or edge cases would change your approach?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Compares alternatives and explains why the chosen approach fits.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Gives a memorized solution without explaining applicability.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: What other approach did you consider and why reject it?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Names tests, failure modes, maintainability, and operational checks.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: How would you prove this works in production?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Links technical work to user/customer, business, reliability, or developer impact.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Treats technical correctness as the only outcome.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: What changed for users or operators because of this work?
